## Episode Thesis

This is a political debate episode after the 2026 Swedish election, in which the opposition won by three seats. Daniel Suhonen (Katalys) argues that a red-green government could pursue a pro-growth, debt-financed investment agenda. Gunilla von Platen (entrepreneur) warns that a long government formation, a sick-pay deduction (karensavdrag) reform, higher taxes and energy policy would hurt business. The episode covers government formation, fiscal policy, energy and rising electricity prices; almost no specific equities are discussed, and there are no investment calls.
